title: cnidoscolus oligandrus
intro: Cnidoscolus oligandrus, commonly known as the "cascabel" or "little drum" due to its unique fruit shape, is a plant species that belongs to the Euphorbiaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in various folk medicines to treat various health conditions, offering several health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cnidoscolus oligandrus include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as its antimicrobial and antifungal activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
